worked_solution:
The system can be rewritten in matrix form as 

$$
{x}^{′}=\text{\boldsymbol}f(x)
$$

where $x=[\begin{aligned}x(t) \\ y(t)\end{aligned}]$ and $\text{\boldsymbol}f(x)=[\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}+2y \\ -3x+{y}^{2}\end{aligned}].$

We need to compute the Jacobian matrix (or the total derivative) of $\text{\boldsymbol}f(x).$ 

In our case, we have the following:

$$
\text{\boldsymbol}{f}^{′}(x)=[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂{f}_{1}}{∂x} & \frac{∂{f}_{1}}{∂y} \\ \frac{∂{f}_{2}}{∂x} & \frac{∂{f}_{2}}{∂y}\end{aligned}]
$$

First, we compute the partial derivatives:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂{f}_{1}}{∂x} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}({x}^{2}+2y)=2x,\, & \frac{∂{f}_{1}}{∂y} & =\frac{∂}{∂y}({x}^{2}+2y)=2 \\ \frac{∂{f}_{2}}{∂x} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(-3x+{y}^{2})=-3,\, & \frac{∂{f}_{2}}{∂y} & =\frac{∂}{∂y}(-3x+{y}^{2})=2y\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, we have

$$
\text{\boldsymbol}{f}^{′}(x)=[\begin{aligned}2x & 2 \\ -3 & 2y\end{aligned}].
$$

Next, we evaluate the Jacobian at the equilibrium ${x}^{∗}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]$ to get

$$
\text{\boldsymbol}{f}^{′}({x}^{∗})=[\begin{aligned}2(0) & 2 \\ -3 & 2(0)\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ -3 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, near the equilibrium, the nonlinear system is approximated by

$$
{u}^{′}=[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ -3 & 0\end{aligned}]u,
$$

where the deviation vector is

$$
u=x-{x}^{∗}=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}].
$$
html:
The system can be rewritten in matrix form as x′=\boldsymbolf(x) where x=[x(t)y(t)] and \boldsymbolf(x)=[x2+2y−3x+y2].

We need to compute the Jacobian matrix (or the total derivative) of \boldsymbolf(x).

In our case, we have the following:

\boldsymbolf′(x)=[∂f1∂x∂f1∂y∂f2∂x∂f2∂y]

First, we compute the partial derivatives:

∂f1∂x=∂∂x(x2+2y)=2x,∂f1∂y=∂∂y(x2+2y)=2∂f2∂x=∂∂x(−3x+y2)=−3,∂f2∂y=∂∂y(−3x+y2)=2y

Thus, we have

\boldsymbolf′(x)=[2x2−32y].

Next, we evaluate the Jacobian at the equilibrium x∗=[00] to get

\boldsymbolf′(x∗)=[2(0)2−32(0)]=[02−30].

Finally, near the equilibrium, the nonlinear system is approximated by

u′=[02−30]u,

where the deviation vector is

u=x−x∗=[xy]−[00]=[xy].
